method: Actual generated file:// course pages in headless Chromium, muted. Desktop 1440x1000 and phone 390x844, light and dark.

results.caption_panel_alignment: Matched left edge and width; 16 px caption gap.

adjudicated_raw_candidates.finding: Title-slide internal scrollWidth includes oversized decorative pseudo-element glows. These are clipped by overflow:hidden. Document width and visible content bounds pass; no learner content is clipped.
index.html remains white with dark text when deck dark preference is stored. The maintained Home has its own fixed light stylesheet and no theme switch. Visual review confirms legibility.

screenshot_correction.finding: Initial automated dark module captures were taken during the 500 ms body background transition.
screenshot_correction.action: Verified transition with timed computed-style samples. Regenerated dark representative screenshots after at least 650 ms, with stored theme set before page load. All 124 module states resolve to rgb(25,25,77). No runtime edits.
